With billions of people worldwide still locked out of mainstream payment systems, it's time to consider a permanent structural alternative at the base layer.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Courses teachable

This problem of being excluded from payment platforms isn't just about Teachable or Stripe; it's about a deeper issue of infrastructure sovereignty. When you rely on third-party payment platforms, you're at their mercy, subject to their rules and restrictions. By building a sovereign digital commerce stack, you're taking control of your own infrastructure, free from the limitations of mainstream payment systems. This means you can sell courses, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-complete-infrastructure-guide-5|COREMERCH guide to ebooks]], software, and other digital products without being locked out by payment providers like Teachable or Stripe.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

A sovereign digital commerce stack is a combination of free and paid tools that give you a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This means you can host your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, process payments with NOWPayments, and deliver files through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, all without relying on mainstream payment providers. With this architecture, you're not just a customer of a payment platform; you're the owner of your own infrastructure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators in countries where mainstream payment platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. It's also for creators who value infrastructure sovereignty and want to take control of their own digital commerce infrastructure. With the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack in just 48 hours, complete with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery.
A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you full control over your infrastructure and allows you to sell courses and other digital products without relying on mainstream payment providers.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of a sovereign digital commerce stack include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. These components work together to give you a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, start by selecting the components that best fit your needs. Choose from the Sovereign Starter Stack, the Edge Commerce Stack, or the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates. Once you've selected your components, follow the deployment steps outlined in the Complete Builder Kit documentation, which includes a comprehensive deployment guide and a scaling playbook. With the Complete Builder Kit, you can instant download everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.

Consider investing in the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates and is worth $348 separately. You can purchase the Complete Builder Kit and other products on our shop page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
Frequently Asked Questions
What are the benefits of a sovereign digital commerce stack?

A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you full control over your infrastructure, automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. It allows you to sell courses and other digital products without relying on mainstream payment providers, giving you greater flexibility and autonomy in your digital business.
Can I use a sovereign digital commerce stack with any cryptocurrency?

Yes, you can use a sovereign digital commerce stack with any cryptocurrency supported by NOWPayments, including 300+ different cryptocurrencies. This means you can accept payments in a variety of digital currencies and give your customers more options when purchasing your courses and other digital products.
How does a sovereign digital commerce stack integrate with NOWPayments?

A sovereign digital commerce stack integrates with NOWPayments through automatic webhook fires, which verify on-chain payment confirmations. This means you can automate your payment processing and ensure that your customers receive their products instantly, without relying on manual intervention.
Can I use a sovereign digital commerce stack with other payment gateways?

No, a sovereign digital commerce stack is optimized for use with NOWPayments and other crypto payment gateways. While you may be able to find workarounds for using other payment gateways, they may not provide the same level of functionality and automation as NOWPayments.
What is the cost of a sovereign digital commerce stack?
